about: The Law Offices of Randy S. Margulis keeps two offices, on Delaware Avenue downtown and on Limestone Drive in Williamsville, and names three attorneys with a bio for each. Its site explains seven stages of a matrimonial case and describes four routes through one, from mediation to trial, which is as many as any firm here.

80 reviews at 3.9. It publishes a page about what a divorce costs that explains the retainer, the hourly rate and the court fees, and it does not say what it charges for any of them, so the page is recorded here as an account of the market rather than as the firm's own terms.
